notes.title: Small update to settings and other QoL changes
notes.notes:
The changes are as follows:
[list]
[*] New buttons to set the fan noise volume (background noise).
[*] When changing the system volume slider, you can now use a button to test the volume.
[*] Small QoL changes to UI elements in chat.
[/list]

notes.title: Now game opens fullscreen
notes.notes: The game now automatically opens fullscreen without the need of pressing Alt + Enter. Nevertheless, you can still press Alt + Enter to reduce the size of the game window.

notes.title: Fixed question answer spelling
notes.notes: One of the questions answers was spelled incorrectly. It has now been fixed.
